description: Project-scoped optional Hindsight bridge. Requires a local Hindsight installation and its own opt-in configuration.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p=(Get-Location).Path; while($p -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p '.codex/hooks/hindsight-bridge.ps1'))){$p=Split-Path $p -Parent}; if($p){$u=New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false); [Console]::InputEncoding=$u; [Console]::OutputEncoding=$u; $OutputEncoding=$u; $data=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $bridge=Join-Path $p '.codex/hooks/hindsight-bridge.ps1'; $data | & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $bridge SessionStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE}"
